Reflection announced Beam on October 5 as a 501B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 23B active parameters; the company plans to release its weights under Apache 2.0 later this month after final red-teaming.

Reflection’s table reports Beam scored 77.2 on SWE-bench Pro v2-Hard versus Kimi K3’s 88.2, and Reflection says it prioritizes inference efficiency; access remains limited to a select early-access group.
